_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
This repo is ALL TOOL: it ships the guard kit and nothing else. It holds no fixtures,
because it has no product to fixture, and it can never hold DATA, because nothing here
_audited: 2026-09-02. The data list is empty because this repo produces no real-run output at all, not
because nobody looked. This is the security kit: the scanner, the data boundary, the companion
resolver and the hooks. It has no companion repo and needs
How that was checked, rather than assumed. Every write in shipped (non-test) code was located:
pii_guard.py grant -> ~/.pii-guard/denylist-exempt.json, OUTSIDE every work tree, and
deliberately so: an exemption granted from inside a repo would let a
leaking agent write its own permission slip in the same commit.
The original standalone kit otherwise writes no runtime store. Its tracked set is code and documentation:
no ledger, no runs tree, no dated output, no database.
_run_shape_probes stays empty for the same reason and is the one honest answer here: a probe
list names what a real run of THIS repo writes, and a real run of this repo writes nothing.

2026-10-05. The shared Python filesystem API writes only to explicit caller-supplied paths; it owns no runtime store or default output path. Credential scans return metadata to the caller or stdout. Package builds contain TOOL code only. No real-run DATA destination is introduced in this repository. Consumers retain responsibility for proving PRIVATE storage and publication authority.
2026-10-15. tools/fleet_sync.py, the CI action and every GitHub workflow were deleted; the kit runs only from the local checkout named by git config fleet.guards and writes no new location.
